title: AI Chip Stocks Gain Momentum On Taiwan Semiconductor Performance;  Biden's Semiconductor Sanctions Kick In
author: Anusuya Lahiri
description: AI chip stocks rise as Taiwan Semiconductor's strong Q4 results boost market sentiment, while the U.S. expands chip sanctions targeting Chinese firms. AI chip demand still drives massive 2024 semiconductor growth.
